title: Testing as the Feedback Loop
youtube_title: Testing as the Feedback Loop: Tests Are Your Agent's Eyes | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 6
description: Give the same agent the same task in two code bases, one with tests and one without, and you get opposite results. This chapter shows why tests are how an agent knows it succeeded, why you should write the test first, and what makes a test useful to an agent: fast, deterministic, isolated, clear, and focused on behaviour. It also covers the kinds of test that give a green light meaning nothing.
